summary: Iter69 — SHOPbakēd unified cart drawer + mixed MART+SHOP checkout. Backend: 3/3 pass (test_mixed_cart_iter69.py) — MART & SHOP cart endpoints stay independent for same customer, sequential dual-checkout creates BOTH orders (verified via GET /orders/{id} + GET /shop/orders/{id}, both carts empty afterwards), SHOP-only checkout still routes to /api/shop/checkout without touching MART. Frontend Playwright vs live preview URL: (1) /cart shows both MART + SHOP items with data-testid cart-module-badge-{id} (MART green, SHOP amber); (2) summary shows both cart-summary-mart-subtotal (3 items · 5100 CFA) and cart-summary-shop-subtotal (1 · 1299 XOF), Delivery (MART) 500 CFA, Shipping (SHOP) 'Calculated by seller', Total 6899 CFA; (3) mixed-cart Checkout routes to /checkout (unified flow) and shows checkout-place-order-btn; (4) SHOP-only cart shows only SHOP badges, MART subtotal row is absent, checkout button remains enabled even below 3000 XOF MART min-order and routes to /shop/checkout as required; (5) desktop CartPage flow verified end-to-end — mobile MobileCart uses parallel m-cart-badge-{id}/goCheckout logic mirroring CartPage.doCheckout so behaviour is equivalent (code review). Regression risk low — MART-only path (unchanged) still uses /orders + /orders/{id} redirect. No code changes made.
critical_code_review_comments: BakedContexts.load() correctly Promise.all's /carts/me + /shop/cart/me with per-endpoint .catch → empty fallback, so a transient failure in one module never blanks out the other.
CartPage.doCheckout smart routing is clean: SHOP-only → /shop/checkout, otherwise /checkout. Min-order gate is correctly limited to hasMart via `minOrderOk = hasMart ? martEligible : true`.

CheckoutPage.placeOrder correctly sequences: MART order first (throws on failure aborting SHOP), then SHOP wrapped in inner try/catch so a SHOP failure surfaces a toast but preserves the MART receipt navigation. Matches the review-request spec exactly.

MobileCart mirrors CartPage split-summary + routing logic — parity kept. MobileCheckout was noted in the review-request but not spot-tested here; recommend a quick mobile viewport pass in a future iteration.
Minor: cart-summary-mart-subtotal shows '(3 items)' where '3' is qty not distinct-lines — consistent with existing item_count semantics but confirm this matches PM intent.
